observations.why: Reported speech of a principal announcing a decision for the group; the collective 'we are adopting' enacts authority-ranking as a decision declared on behalf of the organization.
Proportionality framing — performance gain quantified as a cost-benefit ratio, the hallmark of market-pricing relational logic.
Commissive act by the reported principal committing the organization to a timeline; enacts authority-ranking through unilateral scheduling on behalf of the group.
Note-taker records the principal's decision as settled fact; the declarative recording of a top-down choice enacts authority-ranking.
Proportionality framing restated in the decision summary — quantified benefit as justification, the logic of market-pricing.
Timeline committed as a directive from the decision-maker; the note-taker records the principal's scheduling authority as settled.
